title: 第7章 凝练法力帝国神器天眼第8章 赤阳心灯诛邪穿越
content_zh:
采炼大日紫气的快乐相当短暂的。
当太阳升起，过了采炼太阳紫气的时机，陆羽顿感从天而降的大日火气变得暴躁炽热。
仅是吸取一点，都感觉浑身燥热，五内俱焚。
“肉身太弱，采不了一点大日火气，先撤！”
陆羽谨记赤鸦炼日诀上的要点，及时停下采气之举，返回家里。
采大日紫气，只是修行赤鸦炼日诀的第一步。
趁着道土还算温热，大日紫气存于内。
陆羽盘坐于床，手掐炼日印，内观道土，运起赤鸦炼日诀中的炼化法门。
这法门涉及观想之法，需心中观想出一枚火鸦形制的繁复赤色道文，然后引导道土内的大日紫气，一笔一画地勾勒绘制。
赤色道文繁复灵动，是由九道细小的赤红符箓构成，最是复杂。
昨夜，陆羽研究学习此法，大部分功夫都耗费在记忆这枚赤色道文上。
一笔又一笔，用心勾勒，渐渐成型。
但此等涉及精神的精细活，又岂是容易之事。
“啪嗒！”
忽的，全神贯注的陆羽心中升起一丝杂念，分了神，勾勒到了三分之一的赤色符文顿时崩溃，在道土中炸出一团火花。
绘制失败，精神震荡，陆羽脑袋微微眩晕，休息片刻后才恢复了状态。
“第一次失败！”
陆羽轻吐一口气，总结经验，再尝试第二次。
第二次，陆羽刚一开始，就画错了一笔，直接失败.......
一次两次，一共炼习了六次。

直到道土之中的大日紫气消耗殆尽，陆羽一枚赤色道文都未能绘制完成，脑袋还被炸的晕晕的。
倒床就睡，一直睡到下午三四点才醒来，勉强恢复了点精神。
起床后，陆羽跑去地仙管理局，蹭了一顿免费的药膳，填饱肚子。
刚好碰见要下班的罗悦，顺路与她聊聊天，询问一些修炼上的注意事项。
罗悦比陆羽早点成为地仙道修士，加上家里有修士帮衬，懂得比陆羽多多了。
聊到修炼赤鸦炼日诀的过程，罗悦叮嘱陆羽道：
“赤鸦炼日诀虽好，但刚开始炼化大日紫气，凝练法力比较艰难，你采气之余还是多练练静心摄念法，这基础法门练好了，能帮你快点入门赤鸦炼日诀！”
陆羽闻言，若有所思。
罗悦说的很对。
他在修炼过程中，观想道文不够稳定，精神力也有限，容易疲劳。
入门级的静心摄念法明显不够，若是能练到熟练，练到小成，绝对能省事不少。
有了罗悦的提点，陆羽接下来的生活就简单了不少。
每日除了早上，早起采集大日紫气之外，全身心地投入到静心摄念法的修炼中去。
每日唯一的休闲时间，只剩下去管理局蹭一顿饭，顺便与罗悦交流一下修炼经验。
这样的日子，一连过去四五天。
陆羽很听劝。
不再大日紫气凝练赤鸦炼日诀的法力，只是暂存于道土中。
大日紫气的滋养下，陆羽整个人都暖烘烘的。
修炼静心摄念法的消耗的精神，在大日紫气的滋养中，飞速恢复。
恢复快，多练习。

陆羽静心摄念法的熟练度飞速增加，保持着一天十几二十多的熟练度提升。
3月11日。
得到赤鸦炼日诀功法的第4天，陆羽暂时还未入门赤鸦炼日诀。
但他的静心摄念法却是大有进步，已经达到精通层次。
【静心摄念法：8100（精通）】
content_en:
The joy of harvesting the Purple Energy of the Great Sun is quite short-lived.
When the sun rose, after the time to extract the sun's purple energy, Lu Yu suddenly felt that the sun's fire energy falling from the sky became violent and hot.
Just absorbing a little bit makes my whole body feel hot and burning.
"The physical body is too weak to absorb a little of the sun's fire energy, so retreat first!"
Lu Yu remembered the key points of the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique, stopped collecting Qi in time, and returned home.
Collecting the purple energy of the great sun is only the first step in practicing the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique.
While the Dao soil is still warm, the purple energy of the great sun is contained within.
Lu Yu sat cross-legged on the bed, pinched the sun seal with his hands, looked inside the Tao earth, and used the refining method in the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique.
This method involves visualization. You need to visualize a complex red Taoist text in the shape of a fire crow in your mind, and then guide the purple energy of the great sun in the Tao soil to outline it stroke by stroke.
The red Taoist text is complex and smart. It is composed of nine small red talismans. It is the most complicated.
Last night, Lu Yu studied and learned this method, spending most of his time memorizing this red Daoist text.
One stroke after another, carefully sketched, it gradually took shape.
But such delicate work that involves the spirit is not easy.
"Crack!"
Suddenly, a distracting thought arose in Lu Yu's heart, and he was distracted. One-third of the red runes that had been outlined suddenly collapsed, and a ball of sparks exploded in the soil.
The drawing failed and his mind was shaken. Lu Yu's head was slightly dizzy and he recovered after a short rest.
"First failure!"
Lu Yu took a breath, summed up his experience, and tried again.
The second time, Lu Yu made a wrong stroke as soon as he started and failed immediately...
Once and twice, practiced six times in total.
Until the purple energy of the great sun in the Dao soil was exhausted, Lu Yu could not complete a single red Dao text, and his head was still dizzy from the explosion.
I fell into bed and fell asleep. I slept until three or four in the afternoon before waking up, barely regaining my energy.
After getting up, Lu Yu ran to the Dixian Administration Bureau and had a free meal to fill his stomach.
I happened to meet Luo Yue who was about to get off work, so I chatted with her on the way and asked her about some matters needing attention in cultivation.
Luo Yue became an Earth Immortal monk earlier than Lu Yu, and with the help of monks at home, he knew much more than Lu Yu.
Talking about the process of practicing the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique, Luo Yue told Lu Yu:
"Although the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique is good, it is difficult to refine the purple energy of the great sun at the beginning, and it is difficult to condense the magic power. You should practice the method of calming down thoughts while collecting Qi. Once you have mastered this basic method, it will help you quickly get started with the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique!"
Lu Yu was thoughtful after hearing this.
Luo Yue is right.
During his practice, his visualization of the Taoist text was not stable enough, his mental power was limited, and he was prone to fatigue.
The entry-level meditation method is obviously not enough. If you can practice it to a proficient level, it will definitely save a lot of trouble.
With Luo Yue's advice, Lu Yu's life would become much simpler.
Every day, in addition to getting up early in the morning to collect the purple energy of the Great Sun, I devote myself wholeheartedly to the practice of meditation and mindfulness.
The only leisure time every day is to go to the Administration Bureau to have a meal and exchange cultivation experiences with Luo Yue.
Four or five days like this passed in a row.
Lu Yu was very obedient.
The purple energy of the great sun no longer condenses the magic power of the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique, which is only temporarily stored in the Tao soil.
Lu Yu's whole body felt warm under the nourishment of the purple energy of the sun.
The energy consumed by practicing the method of meditating and taking thoughts is quickly restored by the nourishment of the purple energy of the great sun.
Recover quickly, practice more.
Lu Yu's proficiency in the meditation method has increased rapidly, and he has maintained a proficiency increase of more than ten or twenty times a day.
March 11th.
On the fourth day after acquiring the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique, Lu Yu had not yet learned the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique.
However, his meditation method has made great progress and has reached the level of mastery.
[Calm down and take thoughts: 8100 (proficient)]
